sql: SELECT id, title, status FROM article;
SELECT id, article, kind, text FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull' OR text CONTAINS 'retract' OR text CONTAINS 'spike';
SELECT id, title, status, body FROM article WHERE status != 'c_04';
SELECT id, article, kind, text, created_at FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a5, article:a7, article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41];
SELECT kind, count() FROM brief GROUP BY kind; SELECT id, heading, body FROM factbox;
SELECT id, status, published_at, desk FROM article WHERE status != 'c_04' ORDER BY status;

SELECT id, out, in FROM covers WHERE in IN [article:a5, article:a7, article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41] OR out IN [article:a5, article:a7, article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41];
SELECT count() FROM covers GROUP ALL; SELECT id,status FROM article WHERE id IN (SELECT in FROM covers) OR id IN (SELECT out FROM covers);
SELECT id, in, out FROM covers;
